mapper.select: SELECT status FROM user_account WHERE id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM user_account u JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN `role` r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 'ENABLED' AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND p.status = 'ENABLED'
